pages.text: You have discovered that you can train even stranger Illagers.

Well, you really can't blame him for always being so angry. His wife just turned into his ex-wife a second ago, or the bank that held his life's savings just went under... Or maybe he simply saw some tweet? Who knows... Wait, how does he even have a phone?

You've noticed that these bulky brutes are exceptional at absorbing massive amounts of damage. You suspect that through a devilish training regimen, you could turn your Crusher Servants into hulking, powerful muscle mountains!
